label: D2 after choosing a1 and reaching S1 (common a1->S1 transition)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 through the common transition (in_action == 1 and in_state == 1, both observed at D2). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, at S2, or on a1 rare transitions to S2; a handful of tiny activations (about 0.05 of max) occur on a2 -> S1 rare. Dev split: recall 0.9995, mass recall 1.0, precision 0.58. Many a1->S1c steps are silent, and magnitude falls over a run of consecutive rewarded a1->S1c trials: it is largest (near max) on the first common a1->S1 after an unrewarded or rare trial, then decays (e.g. 0.99 -> 0.62 -> 0.43 -> 0.3) and goes to zero during long rewarded streaks. Simple history conditions do not capture this well. Excluding steps whose previous one or two trials were rewarded a1-common raised mass recall to 0.92 but dropped F1 to 0.71, and prev_reward == 0 alone gave F1 0.55. So the gating looks like a decaying recency or surprise signal for the a1/S1 state, carried in magnitude. Firing becomes more likely later in the episode. Recorded with only observed variables.
